text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
I never thought I'd actually get it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, getting so serious over a game...
You really hate losing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but since you went through the trouble of getting it for me,
I suppose I'll treasure it."
